title: Cosmic Lizard and Wanderer
description: A surreal painting depicts a large black lizard-like creature standing on the left, facing a vibrant central spiral galaxy of pink, magenta, and white with embedded flowers and multiple faces. A small white human figure with a backpack and walking stick stands on a geometric path at the bottom right, looking toward the cosmic scene. The composition is framed by dark leafless tree branches against a starry blue and purple night sky with geometric patterns and constellation lines.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with a large black lizard creature standing on the left side, facing inward toward a massive swirling pink and magenta spiral galaxy at the center that contains white flowers, multiple human faces, and smaller orbiting planets. A small white human wanderer with backpack and walking stick stands on a geometric triangular path at the bottom right. The entire composition is framed by dark leafless tree branches at the top against a deep blue and purple starry sky filled with constellation lines and geometric patterns, high contrast black background.
